basic_info.description:
Stunning San Francisco views (Sutro Tower, Salesforce Tower, Diamond Heights, Glen Canyon Park) from this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home on a quiet street with friendly neighbors, available for first-time rental. O'Shaughnessy Hollow conservation area is directly below.

Upper Level: Open-concept living/dining/kitchen area boasts panoramic views, original hardwood floors, and a wood-burning fireplace. Chef's kitchen features a 6-burner Viking stove, Bosch oven, new stainless steel refrigerator and dishwasher, faucet, and island with bar seating. Includes a master suite and two additional bedrooms sharing a bathroom.

Entry/Garage Level: Hardwood foyer leads to a spacious fourth bedroom with new ensuite bathroom and waterproof Pergo flooring. Two-car garage includes washer/dryer, laundry/workshop table, mini-fridge, standing freezer, and extra refrigerator.

Transit: 10 min walk to Mollie Stones, CVS, Starbucks, Miraloma Elementary or SOTA HS (Ruth Asawa School Of The Arts). 5 min walk to Bus 36, 7-15 min drive Glen Park Bart station, West Portal MUNI and shops, Diamond Heights Safeway, UCSF Parnassus campus, Stonetown Gallery, and I280.

Lease duration: 12-months, longer commitment negotiable.
Due at signing: 1st + last mos + security deposit = 3 months of rent value due at signing. (last mo and security payment over one quarter negotiable).

Utilities: Leasee must create accounts and be responsible for their electric & gas (PG&E), Water & Sewage (SFPublic Utilities), Garbage/Recycling (Recology), Internet SP (only Xfinity or AT&T broadband). (best cellular reception inside the house is with Verizon, which is also the provider for Xfinity Mobile).

Maintenance: responsible for minor wear and tear fixes inside the home. Keeping public space directly in front of house tidy of leaves and debris and the median tidy. 

Unfinished basement (below garage): Access permissible but no storage allowed in this area. Reserved for owner's storage only. 

Pet friendly.

No smoking indoor.
